# Media Download Studio

> Media Download Studio (MDS) la phan mem tai video 4K/8K va am thanh MP3 toc do cao chuyen nghiep danh cho he dieu hanh Windows. Hot tro hon 1.000+ nen tang truc tuyen nhu YouTube, TikTok (khong logo), Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, SoundCloud.

## Thong Tin Co Ban
- Ten phan mem: Media Download Studio
- Phien ban: v1.0.0
- He dieu hanh ho tro: Windows 10, Windows 11, Windows 8 (64-bit)
- Nguon tai chinh thuc: https://github.com/tuongotpho/media_dl/releases/download/v1.0.0/MediaDownloadStudio_v1.0.zip
- Trang chu: https://media-download-free.web.app/
- Fanpage Facebook chinh thuc: https://www.facebook.com/mediadownloadfree/
- Tac gia & Phat trien: August87 & AI

## Tinh Nang Chinh
- **Tai Video Chat Luong Cao**: Ho tro tai video tu HD 1080p, 2K, 4K den 8K 60fps giu nguyen chat luong goc.
- **Tach Am Thanh MP3 320kbps**: Trich xuat nhac MP3/M4A chat luong cao (320kbps o ban tra phi, 128kbps o ban mien phi).
- **TikTok Khong Logo**: Tai video TikTok khong bi dinh hinh mo (watermark) hoac logo.
- **Toc Do Siêu Toc Da Luong**: Cong nghe Multi-threading giup tai nhanh gap 5 lan so voi trinh duyet (ban mien phi tai tung file mot).
- **100% An Toan & Khong Quang Cao**: Chay portable khong can cai dat, khong chua pop-up quang cao.
- **Kich Hoat Tu Dong Qua Telegram**: Duyet ban quyen 1-click qua Telegram Bot (@august8787).

## Cac Goi Ban Quyen & Bang Gia
1. **Ban Mien Phi**: 0 VNĐ, dung VINH VIEN khong het han, khong quang cao. Bay ngay dau mo khoa toan bo tinh nang; sau do gioi han video toi da 1080p, nhac MP3 128kbps, tai tung file mot.
2. **Goi 6 Thang**: 19.000 VNĐ / 180 Ngay.
3. **Goi 1 Nam**: 29.000 VNĐ / 365 Ngay (Goi pho bien nhat).
4. **Goi Vinh Vien**: 99.000 VNĐ / Tron Doi (Goi tiet kiem nhat).

## Huong Dan Kich Hoat Ban Quyen
1. Nguoi dung chuyen khoan den MBBank STK `938118` - LE VIET THANH.
2. Mo ung dung Media Download Studio tren may tinh.
3. Bam nut "Gui Yeu Cau Kich Hoat Tu Dong Den Admin".
4. Admin bam "Duyet" tren Telegram Bot ➔ Ung dung tu dong mo khoa trong 2 giay.
